message.content:
The editorial illustration is a vertical rectangular composition dominated by a white background with a red vertical stripe on the left edge. At the top center, the large black serif word "TEMPO" is partially overlaid by a massive red question mark. The question mark's curved top sits behind the letters, while its stem descends toward the bottom center.

Directly below the question mark's base is a small red silhouette of a four-engine propeller aircraft, shown in an angled downward dive. To the left of the question mark, black sans-serif text reads: "Jatuh di Medan, Hercules C-130B diduga rusak mesin. Ada penumpang gelap dalam pesawat nahas itu".

At the very top, two headlines are separated by a thin diagonal line: "MANUVER GOLKAR MENUNDA PILKADA" on the left and "BEREBUT ATUR IMPOR DUA KEMENTERIAN" on the right. Below the main title is the date "6-12 JULI 2015". The bottom right contains "RP 39.500", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00019". A dark maroon horizontal band anchors the bottom.
